definitions.explanation: The act of nurturing and raising a child, providing food, shelter, education, and care until they can be independent.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{養育|よういく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an obligation to raise the child.

examples.japanese: {養育|よういく}{費|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{払|はら}っている→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I pay child support every month.

examples.japanese: {離婚後|りこんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{養育|よういく}{権|けん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: We discussed custody rights after the divorce.

notes:
{養育|よういく} refers to the act of raising and nurturing a child — providing food, shelter, education, and care. It is a formal term commonly used in legal and official contexts.

FORMS:
{養|よう} (nurture, support) + {育|いく} (raise, grow).

COMPOUNDS:
- {養育|よういく}{費|ひ}: child support payments
- {養育|よういく}{権|けん}: custody (rights to raise a child)
- {養育|よういく}⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: child-rearing environment
- {養育|よういく}{者|しゃ}: caregiver, person raising a child

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧: childcare (day-to-day care, especially of infants/toddlers)
- ⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧: raising children (everyday, colloquial)
- {養護|ようご}: protective care (institutional contexts, e.g., ⟦{養護|ようご}{施設|しせつ}→養護施設：15913_yougoshisetsu⟧)
